mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0), which signals a supply-side contraction, corporate output and profit margins are pressured, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in payroll growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% per annum signals accelerating inflation, which triggers expectations of monetary policy tightening and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deceleration in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% and HOUST declines
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% and HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.
